info.title: yebeyt API
info.description: Errors are `{ "error": code }`; the apps turn the codes into Persian copy.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, valid 60 days, single use: every refresh returns a new one.

allowedAt.description: With username_change_too_soon: when the next change is allowed.

nonce.description: The raw nonce; its sha256 was sent to Apple. Required: the identity token must carry its sha256.

fullName.description: Accepted and ignored: the server keeps no names.

displayName.description: 1–30 characters after trimming, no control characters.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

roundId.description: Made by the phone for each round; sending it again does not count twice.

league.description: This week's tier; before the first score of the week, the tier the user will start in.

week.description: The Tehran week, Saturday to Friday.

tier.description: 0 نوآموز, 1 بیت‌خوان, 2 غزل‌باز, 3 سخن‌دان, 4 استاد سخن.

endsAt.description: When the week ends (Friday midnight in Tehran).

rows.description: My league group, best first. Empty until my first score of the week.

username.description: Null for someone who has not chosen a username yet.

week.description: The Tehran week, Saturday to Friday.
The Tehran week, Saturday to Friday.

allOf.description: My own rank, even when I am not on the list (my `inGlobalLeaderboard` is off). Null before my first score of the week.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

version.description: First 12 characters of the picture's sha256; changes when the picture does.

url.description: Path on this server, to be resolved against its address.

uploadToken.description: Random, valid 15 minutes: send it as X-Upload-Token when uploading attachments.

FeedbackRequest.description: Rules per type. bug: text, optional frequency, screen and technical. annoyed: text, optional screen. idea and liked: text only. game: a `game` idea, text optional. appVersion, deviceModel and osVersion go with every type. The body is limited to 32 KB.

FeedbackTechnical.description: Only these keys; anything else is refused.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page.

username.description: Null for guests, for users with no username yet, and after the account is deleted.

get.summary: The divan: kept and removed couplets

200.description: Every item stored for the user.

put.summary: Merge the phone's divan into the stored one
put.description: Up to 2000 items per request and 20000 per user. Items with no timestamp are ignored. Per key the later keptAt and the later removedAt win, so a couplet is kept when keptAt is after removedAt. Repeating a request changes nothing. A timestamp more than 5 minutes ahead of the server's clock is refused (bad_timestamp). Answers the full merged state.

200.description: Every item stored for the user.

400.description: invalid_request, or bad_timestamp for a time too far ahead.

413.description: payload_too_large (body over 1 MB), or divan_full (the user would have more than 20 000 items).

get.description: `isFriend` is true when I follow them back. People with no username yet are left out.

get.description: Ordered by when I followed them, newest first. `isFriend` is always true.

post.description: Idempotent on `roundId` (the same user sending it again gets the stored result and nothing is added; another user's round id is 409 `conflict`). `points` over the game's cap is 400 `points_too_high` (daily 100, jigsaw 320, poet, second and book 440, match 50, listen 100, onboarding 50). `playedAt` must be within the last 48 hours and at most 5 minutes ahead (400 `bad_timestamp`). The round counts for the Tehran week the server receives it in, and the first score of a week puts the user in a league group.

200.description: The week and the user's points this week.

409.description: conflict: the round id belongs to another user.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

post.description: One result per Tehran day, kept first-write-wins: sending the day again changes nothing and answers the stored result. `date` may be from 48 hours ago (by Tehran date) up to today (400 `bad_timestamp`). `tries` is 1 to 3, also when not solved. The points go in `/v1/scores`.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: How my friends did in a day's puzzle
get.description: Friends (people who follow each other) who reported that day, solved first, then by fewer tries, up to 100. A friend whose `dailyVisibility` is `me` is left out, and not counted. `solvedCount` is how many of the listed friends solved it.

get.summary: My points, streak and league
get.description: `totalPoints` and `weekPoints` come from the reported rounds. `streakDays` counts the days in a row the daily puzzle was solved (reported results, Tehran dates), ending today or yesterday; it stays until the day after the missed one ends.

get.summary: My league this week
get.description: Groups of up to 30 people of one tier. The first score of a week puts me in a group of the tier I earned last week (tier 0 to begin with). At the week's end the top 5 move up a tier and the bottom 5 down (ties go to the earlier last score). Before my first score of the week `rows` is empty and `tier` is the one I will start in.

get.summary: This week's points: me and my friends
get.description: Friends are people who follow each other. Friends with no score are listed with 0. Best first, then by username; up to 100.

get.summary: This week's points: everyone who allows it
get.description: People with `inGlobalLeaderboard` on (and a username) who scored this week, best first (ties by user id), 50 a page. `me` is my own rank among them, also when I am hidden; null before my first score of the week.

get.summary: Who may see and reach me
get.description: The stored settings, or the defaults when none were stored.

put.description: Only the fields sent change; the rest keep their value (or the default).

get.description: Case-insensitive. `reason` says why not: too_short, too_long, bad_chars, reserved, taken.

429.description: Too many requests (60 a minute per user).

post.summary: Send a report: a bug, something annoying, an idea, a game idea or a thank-you
post.description: Signing in is optional; when signed in the report carries the user (the admin sees the username). Signed-in users may send 10 an hour; all guests together 120 an hour. Nothing about the connection is stored. Answers an upload token for the attachments.

400.description: Breaks the rules for its type.

401.description: A token was sent but it is not valid.

put.summary: Attach a screenshot to a report
put.description: For reports of type bug, annoyed, idea; image/jpeg or image/png, at most 3 MB, and the first bytes must match the declared type; one per report, within 15 minutes of sending it. Hourly budget: 200 MB per signed-in user, 500 MB for all guests' reports together; refused uploads cost nothing. At most 3 uploads are handled at once, and the file must arrive within 60 seconds.

400.description: Empty, or the report's type takes no screenshot.

403.description: Wrong, missing or expired upload token.

408.description: upload_timeout: the file took longer than the time allowed to arrive.

409.description: already_uploaded: this report already has a screenshot.

415.description: Wrong media type, or the file does not start like the declared type.

429.description: rate_limited: the hourly upload budget is used up (200 MB per signed-in user; 500 MB for all guests together).

503.description: busy: too many uploads at once; retry after the Retry-After seconds.

put.summary: Attach a recording to a report
put.description: For reports of type bug; video/mp4, at most 25 MB, and the first bytes must match the declared type; one per report, within 15 minutes of sending it. Hourly budget: 200 MB per signed-in user, 500 MB for all guests' reports together; refused uploads cost nothing. At most 3 uploads are handled at once, and the file must arrive within 60 seconds.

400.description: Empty, or the report's type takes no recording.

403.description: Wrong, missing or expired upload token.

408.description: upload_timeout: the file took longer than the time allowed to arrive.

409.description: already_uploaded: this report already has a recording.

415.description: Wrong media type, or the file does not start like the declared type.

429.description: rate_limited: the hourly upload budget is used up (200 MB per signed-in user; 500 MB for all guests together).

503.description: busy: too many uploads at once; retry after the Retry-After seconds.
